verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents merchant deposits with configurable deposit frequency, webhooks for resource events, an embeddable reporting component, and platform ownership of data with export "at any time." Together these suggest reconciliation building blocks, but the pack never describes settlement or balance reports themselves. Missing for 10: explicit settlement/balance report APIs or file exports (e.g. CSV/SFTP), per-seller and platform rolled-up reporting, scheduled report delivery, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
